DESCRIPTION
This week on StrictlyVC Download, Circle co-founder Sean Neville joins Alex Gove of StrictlyVC to
discuss building banking infrastructure for AI agents. Fresh off Circle’s 450% IPO surge, Neville has
raised $18 million from a16z to create Catena Labs, the first fully regulated AI-native financial
institution. They explore what “agent-native finance” actually means, how AI agents will soon handle
our payments and treasury management, and why the financial world needs new standards and
protocols to make this safe and reliable.
